jobs.description: About Testlio Hi there! We're Testlio, a global software testing company that has been helping businesses improve their digital products since 2012. We work with companies around the world to test websites, mobile apps, and online payment systems. Our freelance community helps us identify issues and make sure these products work as expected for real customers. Learn more about us at www.testlio.com . We're looking for people in Paraguay and Uruguay to help test online payments for an international payments technology company. Requirements Location: Currently living in Paraguay or Uruguay. Payment methods: Access to at least one of the following: Paraguay: Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Infonet, USDC, USDT. Uruguay: Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Diners Club, OCA, Lider, Creditel, Mercado Pago Wallet/Connect, USDC, USDT. Comfortable following written instructions and sharing feedback in English. Frequency: Expected weekly opportunities, with occasional additional requests. Work type: Remote, freelance, and flexible. You don't need access to every payment method. Having one is enough to apply! What You'll Do Follow simple, step-by-step instructions from our testing team. Complete small, authorized test transactions using eligible payment methods. Check whether payments are successful or if any errors appear. Share your results and report issues, including screenshots when needed. Why do we need local testers? Payment methods work differently from country to country. A transaction that works in one country might fail in another. That's why we need people who live locally and have access to the payment methods customers actually use. Your role is to help us check whether payments work correctly and report any issues you find. No previous software testing experience is required. Privacy & Security We take the protection of personal and financial information seriously. You'll only be asked to complete authorized testing activities. Never share passwords, full card numbers, or sensitive account information in your reports. Interested in joining us? All official email communications will come from a @testlio.com email address, so please keep an eye on your inbox! #LI-REMOTE

jobs.description: About Customer.io Over 9,000 companies — from scrappy startups to global brands — use our platform to send billions of emails, push notifications, in-app messages, and SMS every day. Customer.io powers automated communication that people actually want to receive. We help teams send smarter, more relevant messages using real-time behavioral data. You'll help customers reach the inbox by diagnosing sending issues, advising on best practices, and guiding senders through an email ecosystem that keeps changing. You'll partner with Customer Success, Technical Support, and Engineering: taking customer calls, equipping CSMs for customer conversations, working through complex technical cases alongside Engineering, and turning what you see in tickets into documentation, training, and better processes. You'll thrive here if you think about the health of the whole program, enjoy improving how work gets done, and are equally comfortable digging into a detailed case and having a direct conversation with a customer about acceptable use. Clarity: You explain complex technical concepts simply and help others do the same. Collaboration: You build strong partnerships across Support, Customer Success, and Engineering, and you treat customer outcomes as a shared goal. jobs.title: AI QA Trainer – LLM Evaluation
jobs.description: Are you an AI QA expert eager to shape the future of AI? Large-scale language models are evolving from clever chatbots into enterprise-grade platforms. With rigorous evaluation data, tomorrow’s AI can democratize world-class education, keep pace with cutting-edge research, and streamline workflows for teams everywhere. That quality begins with you—we need your expertise to harden model reasoning and reliability. We’re looking for AI QA trainers who live and breathe model evaluation, LLM safety, prompt robustness, data quality assurance, multilingual and domain-specific testing, grounding verification, and compliance/readiness checks. You’ll challenge advanced language models on tasks like hallucination detection, factual consistency, prompt-injection and jailbreak resistance, bias/fairness audits, chain-of-reasoning reliability, tool-use correctness, retrieval-augmentation fidelity, and end-to-end workflow validation—documenting every failure mode so we can raise the bar. On a typical day, you will converse with the model on real-world scenarios and evaluation prompts, verify factual accuracy and logical soundness, design and run test plans and regression suites, build clear rubrics and pass/fail criteria, capture reproducible error traces with root-cause hypotheses, and suggest improvements to prompt engineering, guardrails, and evaluation metrics (e.g., precision/recall, faithfulness, toxicity, and latency SLOs). You’ll also partner on adversarial red-teaming, automation (Python/SQL), and dashboarding to track quality deltas over time. A bachelor’s, master’s, or PhD in computer science, data science, computational linguistics, statistics, or a related field is ideal; shipped QA for ML/AI systems, safety/red-team experience, test automation frameworks (e.g., PyTest), and hands-on work with LLM eval tooling (e.g., OpenAI Evals, RAG evaluators, W&B) signal fit. Skills that stand out include: evaluation rubric design, adversarial testing/red-teaming, regression testing at scale, bias/fairness auditing, grounding verification, prompt and system-prompt engineering, test automation (Python/SQL), and high-signal bug reporting. Clear, metacognitive communication—“showing your work”—is essential. Ready to turn your QA expertise into the quality backbone for tomorrow’s AI? Apply today and start teaching the model that will teach the world. We offer a pay range of $6-to- $65 per hour, with the exact rate determined after evaluating your experience, expertise, and geographic location. Final offer amounts may vary from the pay range listed above. As a contractor you’ll supply a secure computer and high-speed internet; company-sponsored benefits such as health insurance and PTO do not apply. Employment type: Contract Workplace type: Remote Seniority level: Mid-Senior Level Originally posted on Himalayas

jobs.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.description: Please note that we will never request payment or bank account information at any stage of the recruitment process. As we continue to grow our teams, we urge you to be cautious of fraudulent job postings or recruitment activities that misuse our company name and information. Please protect your personal information during any recruitment process. While Monks may contact potential candidates via LinkedIn, all applications must be submitted through our official website ( monks.com/careers ). Senior Site Reliability Engineer About the Role As a Senior Site Reliability Engineer, you'll join a dedicated, 100% remote team working closely with a major global client in the healthcare and life sciences industry. You will play a pivotal role in ensuring the reliability, scalability, and security of public-facing services by implementing SLOs, automating toil, and managing robust observability platforms. We are looking for someone who is highly communicative, proactive, and thrives in an open, tech-centric culture. You must be comfortable taking the initiative, mentoring fellow engineers, and confidently communicating technical solutions in fluent English to both technical peers and client stakeholders. Responsibilities: Implement and maintain SLOs, SLIs, and error budgets for owned services to balance reliability with feature development. Build and maintain observability across services using metrics, logs, traces, and alerting to ensure actionable signals tied to user impact. Lead capacity planning, load testing, and resilience testing for critical, public-facing services. Automate manual processes and toil to improve operational efficiency, minimize human error, and streamline CI/CD pipelines. Contribute to the platform's reliability through Terraform and Kubernetes configuration on AWS, strictly adhering to Cloud Platform standards. Participate in on-call rotations and incident management, responding with urgency, troubleshooting complex issues, and driving blameless postmortems. Mentor and guide other engineers, fostering a culture of operational excellence, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning within the team. About You The essentials: Strict geographical requirement: You must be currently residing in Costa Rica (role is 100% remote within the country). Extensive hands-on experience as a Site Reliability Engineer managing production systems, including implementing SLOs, error budgets, and incident response. Working proficiency managing infrastructure with Kubernetes and Terraform on AWS environments. Deep experience with observability platforms (such as Datadog) and designing effective, actionable alert systems. Strong scripting and programming skills (e.g., Python, Go) for automation and custom tooling. Outstanding communication skills and fluent English; you must be proactive, participate actively with your camera on, and comfortably articulate technical solutions without relying on AI-generated scripts. jobs.title: Senior Data Analyst, Marketing Measurement
jobs.description: Help Us Build The Future of Travel At Airalo , we're making it easier for people to stay connected wherever they travel. As the world's first eSIM store, we help millions of travelers access affordable mobile data in 200+ countries and regions around the world. Today, we're a team of 400+ people across 60+ countries, building a product used by travelers every day. We've grown quickly, but we've worked hard to keep what matters: trust, ownership, and the freedom for people to do great work without unnecessary layers or bureaucracy. We're fully remote by design, genuinely global, and united by a shared mission to make travel simpler for everyone. Your Next Destination Location: Remote. Contract: Full-time, permanent. Benefits: Learn more about our benefits here in this link - https://airalo-public.notion.site/Benefits-25396a97ffca81fb9bc1f0be479f1be3?pvs=74 Languages: English is our main working language day to day, so you'll need to be comfortable communicating in it both in meetings and async. Airalo's fully remote Data team is growing, and so is our ambition for how we measure marketing. You'll help Airalo decide where to invest the next dollar by owning how we measure marketing performance: attribution, the data models behind it, and incrementality testing that shows what really works, turning evidence into investment decisions across the globe. You'll pair solid measurement expertise, including causal inference, with strong core analytics. You'll guide teams on what to measure and test, defend our framework with senior stakeholders, and make sure data changes decisions. This is a small, growing team and a capability that is new to the business: you'll build the process, not inherit it. Expect your time to be split between measurement work (attribution, data modelling and incrementality) and the day-to-day analytics Growth and Marketing rely on. What You'll Do Support our marketing attribution models and methodology: review how conversions are credited across channels, reconcile platform-reported and first-party numbers, and keep the approach trusted and documented. Design and maintain the marketing data models behind measurement (spend, attribution, orders and customer cohorts) with Analytics Engineering, with clear definitions, tests and documentation. Support Growth and Marketing with ad-hoc and core analytics, such as campaign and market performance, self-serve dashboards and AI-assisted analytics. Design and run geo experiments from simulation-based power analysis and market selection to success criteria and read-out, working with the marketing performance team. Co-own a prioritised quarterly incrementality test roadmap across channels and markets, ranked by decision value, cost, feasibility (including properly powered tests) and learning, and track each test through to a decision. Handle spillover, seasonality and small-market noise, and report incremental CAC and incremental ROAS with honest uncertainty. Turn test results into investment
